💾 Backup

✅ Automatic Firestore backups (Blaze plan)
Your database is already covered by Firestore's own scheduled backup / point-in-time-recovery feature — a server-side Google Cloud setting, not something this app controls.
ℹ️ Important — please read
A phone-app or website like this one has no way to check whether that automatic backup ran, when it last ran, or where it's stored — Firebase doesn't expose that to regular apps, only to the project owner via the Firebase/Google Cloud Console. So this screen can't show a "Backup Status: Active ✅" light — showing one without really checking would be misleading.

To verify it yourself (2 min): open the Firebase Console → your project (rel-gym) → Firestore Database → Databases tab → look at the Scheduled backups column for (default) → View backups. That page shows every backup taken and when.
Manual backup (this app)
As a second, independent copy you can keep yourself, download everything currently in the app below. This doesn't replace or change Firestore's own backup — it's just an extra copy on your device.

🔐 Manage Access

Owner-only. Tap a staff login below to control what they can see and do. Import and Export stay off by default for a new login — everything else starts on. Changes take effect once you tap Save.

📥 Bulk Import Members

📋 Excel / CSV Format:
Columns (in order): Name, Member ID, Phone, Plan, Status, Fee Due Date, Join Date, Notes
• Name is required — every other column is optional
• Member ID: leave blank if you don't use one; if provided it must be unique
• Date format: YYYY-MM-DD (e.g. 2026-06-15)
• Plan: Monthly / Quarterly / Half-yearly / Annual
• Status: active / inactive / pending / expired / new
• First row can be a header — it will be skipped automatically

📥 Bulk Import Payments

📋 Excel / CSV Format:
Needs a header row with at least Member ID and Payment Date. Also recognised if present: Amount, Payment Mode, Reference, Remarks — any of these left blank fill in automatically (Amount → the member's plan fee, Mode → Cash).
• Payment Date accepts YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY or DD-MM-YYYY
• Member ID must already exist in the app — add new members first via Bulk Import Members
• If a member appears more than once, the earliest date is applied first so the fee due date ends up correct
• Same format works every month — reuse this for future imports
